superseded_physical_producer.what_it_proved: physical Coordinator separation: CPU-only control plane on inferswarm00, remote realization/execution on inferswarm01/03, exact reference tokens, fencing, reclamation
superseded_physical_producer.why_superseded: its remote wire epoch identity was plan-derived (remote-realization:<plan-digest-prefix>, derived independently on both sides) rather than activation-derived Coordinator epoch/generation authority; the same plan digest could therefore imply the same remote epoch authority, violating the requirement that every activation carry distinct epoch/generation authority
superseded_physical_producer.evidence_disposition: retained in git history (commit 861a404); not deleted; not citable as the final canonical proof

corrected_physical_producer.design: realization-authorization record allocated by EpochServingController before realization (prospective authoritative epoch id, prospective generation, plan digest, unique realization-attempt nonce); passed to the realizer; adopted verbatim by the activated Epoch; failed/superseded/retired attempt identities are dead forever; wire binds epoch/generation/realization identity on REALIZE/GENERATE/REPORT/CLOSE; Node agent consumes (never derives) the Coordinator identity and refuses retired authorizations

canonical_run.gpu_census: both nodes 1 MiB used, zero compute processes
canonical_run.coordinator_purity: no /dev/nvidia*, no nvidia-smi, no nvidia kernel modules, 32 MB tokenizer metadata, zero .safetensors

corrected_physical_producer.status: superseded by 2bcf33f (result-identity validation gap); evidence retained in git history (commit 1bc8bdf)

note: Historical R5 evidence was not rerun, per gate instructions.

final_physical_producer.why_the_correction_was_needed: the corrected remote wire bound Coordinator-owned epoch/generation/realization/plan on both ends, but successful result-side identity was incomplete: the Node agent echoed session_id but not position, and RemoteEpochRuntime._request validated neither the returned scope id, session id, nor execution position — a syntactically valid response attributed to the wrong session or position would have been accepted
final_physical_producer.design: node agent echoes the request position on every successful response; coordinator response validation compares the returned identity against the exact request just sent (protocol, scope, epoch/generation/realization/plan, operation, session/position where applicable); GENERATE additionally verifies the runtime result session identity; any mismatch fails closed before on_token or result commitment, with no reliance on TCP ordering

canonical_run.gpu_census: both nodes 1 MiB used, zero compute processes
canonical_run.coordinator_purity: xc control-plane modules import torch-free on inferswarm00

regression_of_record.claim: A correctness-bearing remote result must be attributable to the authorized session/request and expected execution position
